name: Guarantee Details 1
definition: Indicates the details of a guarantee.

Position.name: Position
Position.definition: Rank of the guarantee provider. A value of 1 means highest rank. Providers may have the same position.

GuaranteedAmount.name: Guaranteed Amount
GuaranteedAmount.definition: Amount by time periods, maximum value applies at any given date.

Excess.name: Excess
Excess.definition: Amount not covered by the guarantee. Maximum value applies at any given date.

CoveredPercentage.name: Covered Percentage
CoveredPercentage.definition: Covered percentage, the maximum value applies at any given date.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the demand.
